verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad public REST API that covers transactions, budgets, expenses with receipt upload, payments and vendors, team and users, travel, accounting and webhooks. Access uses dashboard-generated, scoped user tokens, and the API is backed by an active changelog, Postman collections and an llms.txt index, so the product can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a standard discoverable path (the probes returned 404).
